{{Short description|none}} {{Use American English|date=February 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=June 2025}} {{Infobox election | election_name = 2026 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota's at-large district | country = South Dakota | type = presidential | ongoing = yes | previous_election = 2024 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota | previous_year = 2024 | election_date = November 3, 2026 | next_election = 2028 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota | next_year = 2028 | turnout = | image1 = US District Attorney Marty Jackley (3x4 crop).png | nominee1 = [[Marty Jackley]] | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | popular_vote1 = | percentage1 = | image2 = 3x4.svg | nominee2 = Nikki Gronli | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | map_image = | map_size = 250px | map_caption = | title = U.S. Representative | before_election = [[Dusty Johnson]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} {{Elections in South Dakota sidebar}} The '''2026 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota''' is scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States House of Representatives]] to represent the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[South Dakota]] from its {{ushr|SD|AL|D}}. The election will coincide with [[2026 South Dakota elections|other elections]] held on the same date. The primary elections will be held on June 2, 2026, and in races where no candidate receives at least 35% in a primary, runoff elections took place on July 28.{{Cite web |title=South Dakota 2026 General Election |url=https://www.thegreenpapers.com/G26/SD |access-date=2025-06-13 |website=The Green Papers}} Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] representative [[Dusty Johnson]] was re-elected with 72.0% of the vote in 2024.{{Cite web |title=2024 House Vote Tracker |url=https://www.cookpolitical.com/vote-tracker/2024/house |access-date=2025-06-13 |website=[[Cook Political Report]] |language=en}} [[Primary election]]s were held on June 2, 2026. Jackley received 79.2% of the vote against minimal opposition and Gronli ran unopposed for their respective party's nominations. Republicans have not lost a Congressional election in South Dakota since [[2008 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota|2008]]. == Republican primary == === Candidates === ==== Nominee ==== *[[Marty Jackley]], [[South Dakota Attorney General]] (2009–2019, 2023–present) and candidate for [[Governor of South Dakota|governor]] in [[2018 South Dakota gubernatorial election|2018]]{{Cite web |last=Dausch |first=Dominik |date=June 27, 2025 |title=Marty Jackley plans to run for US Rep.
